arxiv-1807-11507.title: The Serendipity of Electroweak Baryogenesis
arxiv-1807-11507.creator: Géraldine Servant 1,2
arxiv-1807-11507.description: Abstract The origin of the matter antimatter asymmetry of the universe remains unexplained in the Standard Model of particle physics. The origin of the flavour structure is another major puzzle of the theory. In this article, we report on recent work attempting to link the two themes through the appealing framework of electroweak baryogenesis.

arxiv-2105-03425.title: Kernel Two-Sample Tests for Manifold Data
arxiv-2105-03425.creator: Xiuyuan Cheng Yao Xie
arxiv-2105-03425.description: Abstract We present a study of a kernel-based two-sample test statistic related to the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) in the manifold data setting, assuming that high-dimensional observations are close to a low-dimensional manifold. We characterize the test level and power in relation to the kernel bandwidth, the number of samples, and the intrinsic dimensionality of the manifold.

arxiv-2205-02524.title: M2R2: Missing-Modality Robust emotion Recognition framework with iterative data augmentation
arxiv-2205-02524.creator: Wang Ning, a
arxiv-2205-02524.description: Abstract This paper deals with the utterance-level modalities missing problem with uncertain patterns on emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) task. Present models generally predict the speaker’s emotions by its current utterance and context, which is degraded by modality missing considerably.

arxiv-2211-02376.title: Growth of A Massive Black Hole In A Dense Star Cluster Via Tidal Disruption Accretion
arxiv-2211-02376.creator: Seungjae Lee, Ji-hoon Kim, Boon Kiat Oh
arxiv-2211-02376.description: Abstract Stars that are tidally disrupted by the massive black hole (MBH) may contribute significantly to the growth of the MBH, especially in dense nuclear star clusters (NSCs). Yet, this tidal disruption accretion (TDA) of stars onto the MBH has largely been overlooked compared to the gas accretion (GA) channel in most numerical experiments until now.

arxiv-2307-12328.creator: Han Hu, Yujin Huang, Qiuyuan Chen, Terry Yue zhuo, Chunyang Chen
arxiv-2307-12328.description: Abstract . Powered by the rising popularity of deep learning techniques on smartphones, on-device deep learning models are being used in vital fields like finance, social media, and driving assistance. Because of the transparency of the Android platform and the on-device models inside, on-device models on Android smartphones have been proven to be extremely vulnerable.

arxiv-2308-02645.title: High-mass X-ray Binaries
arxiv-2308-02645.creator: Francesca M. Fornasini, Vallia Antoniou, and Guillaume Dubus
arxiv-2308-02645.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Francesca M. Fornasini, Vallia Antoniou, and Guillaume Dubus. Binary systems in which a neutron star or black hole accretes material from a high-mass star are known as high-mass X-ray binaries (HMXBs). This chapter provides a brief introduction to the physics of wind accretion and an observational view of HMXBs, including their classification, X-ray spectra, X-ray variability, orbital and compact object properties, as well as studies of Galactic and Magellanic HMXB populations.

arxiv-2501-02372.title: Valley-mediated singlet- and triplet-polaron interactions and quantum dynamics in a doped WSe 2 monolayer
arxiv-2501-02372.creator: Yue Ni, Di Huang, Danfu Liang, Albert Liu, Xiaohui Liu, Kevin Sampson, Zhida Liu, Jianmin Quan, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Dmitry K. Efimkin, Jesper Levinsen, Meera M. Parish, Xiaoqin Li

Efimkin, Jesper Levinsen, Meera M. Parish, Xiaoqin Li. In doped transition metal dichalcogenides, optically created excitons (bound electron-hole pairs) can strongly interact with a Fermi sea of electrons to form Fermi polaron quasiparticles.

arxiv-2506-06263.title: Dynamics of rotationally invariant polynomial root sets under iterated differentiations
arxiv-2506-06263.creator: André Galligo, Joseph Najnudel, Truong Vu
arxiv-2506-06263.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by André Galligo, Joseph Najnudel, Truong Vu. We associate to an N N -sample of a given rotationally invariant probability measure μ 0 \mu_{0} with compact support in the complex plane, a polynomial P N P_{N} with roots given by the sample. Then, for t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) t\in(0,1) , we consider the empirical measure μ t N \mu_{t}^{N} associated to the root set of the ⌊ t ​ N ⌋ \lfloor tN\rfloor -th derivative of P N P_{N} .

arxiv-2506-16477.title: Parallel batch queries on dynamic trees: algorithms and experiments
arxiv-2506-16477.creator: Humza Ikram, Andrew Brady, Daniel Anderson, Guy Blelloch
arxiv-2506-16477.description: Abstract . Dynamic tree data structures maintain a forest while supporting insertion and deletion of edges and a broad set of queries in O ⁡ ( log ⁡ n ) O(\log n) time per operation. Such data structures are at the core of many modern algorithms.

arxiv-2509-17536.title: Investigating the influence of radio-faint AGN activity on the infrared-radio correlation of massive galaxies
arxiv-2509-17536.creator: Giorgia Peluso ,, Ivan Delvecchio ,, Jack Radcliffe, Emanuele Daddi, Roger Deane, Matt Jarvis, Giovanni Zamorani Isabella Prandoni, Myriam Gitti, Cristiana Spingola, Francesco Ubertosi, Mark Sargent, Vernesa Smolčić, Wuji Wang, Jacinta Delhaize, Shuowen Jin, Adam Deller

It is well-known that star-forming galaxies (SFGs) exhibit a tight correlation between their radio and infrared emissions, commonly referred to as the infrared-radio correlation (IRRC).

britannica-1911-waurin-jehan.title: Waurin, Jehan (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-waurin-jehan.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-waurin-jehan.description: Article 'Waurin, Jehan' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the Burgundians at Verneuil and elsewhere, and then occupying a high position at the court of Philip the Good, duke of Burgundy, was sent as ambassador to Rome in 1463. Jehan wrote, or rather compiled, the Recueil des croniques et anchiennes istories de la Grant Bretaigne, a collection of the sources of English history from the earliest times to 1471.

pmc-10522768.title: Association of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease and venous thromboembolic disease in healthy adults in Korea: a nationwide study
pmc-10522768.creator: Chang-Yeon Kim, Namkyun Kim, Jae-Hyung Roh
pmc-10522768.description: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) can lead to a prothrombotic state, which significantly burdens public healthcare systems. This study investigated the relationship between NAFLD and the incidence of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in Korea using National Health Insurance Service-National Sample Cohort 2.0 data.

pmc-10811130.title: Inhibition of CX3CL1 by treadmill training prevents osteoclast-induced fibrocartilage complex resorption during TBI healing
pmc-10811130.creator: Xiao Liu, Mei Zhou, Jindong Tan, Lin Ma, Hong Tang, Gang He, Xu Tao, Lin Guo, Xia Kang, Kanglai Tang, Xuting Bian
pmc-10811130.description: IntroductionThe healing of tendon-bone injuries is very difficult, often resulting in poor biomechanical performance and unsatisfactory functional recovery. The tendon-bone insertion has a complex four distinct layers structure, and previous studies have often focused on promoting the regeneration of the fibrocartilage layer, neglecting the role of its bone end repair in tendon-bone healing.

pmc-11350946.title: A mixed methods study of early childhood providers’ perceptions of the acceptability and feasibility of parenting for lifelong Health tip sheets in Ontario, Canada
pmc-11350946.creator: Mari Dumbaugh, Susan M. Jack, Jenna Ratcliffe, Amanda Sim, Jacinda Burns, Teresa Bennett, Harriet L. MacMillan, Andrea Gonzalez
pmc-11350946.description: BackgroundUniversal parenting campaigns are efficient, cost-effective and can eliminate barriers to accessing conventional, face-to-face parenting interventions. The aims of the CHAMPP4KIDS study were to assess Canadian early childhood providers’ perceptions of the acceptability and feasibility of implementing a universal parenting resource, the Parenting for Lifelong Health tip sheets.

pmc-11491849.title: Neurorights in the Constitution: from neurotechnology to ethics and politics
pmc-11491849.creator: Sergio Ruiz, Luca Valera, Paulina Ramos, Ranganatha Sitaram
pmc-11491849.description: Neuroimaging technologies such as brain–computer interfaces and neurofeedback have evolved rapidly as new tools for cognitive neuroscience and as potential clinical interventions. However, along with these developments, concern has grown based on the fear of the potential misuse of neurotechnology. In October 2021, Chile became the first country to include neurorights in its Constitution.

pmc-11616279.title: Influence of COVID-19 public health restrictions on community-acquired pneumonia pathogens in children in Henan, China: a multicenter retrospective study
pmc-11616279.creator: Yalin Guo, Debin Yang, Yang Cao, Xianfei Ding, LiXia Chen, Beibei Huo, Yuanzhe Li
pmc-11616279.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the distribution of pathogens and epidemiological changes in children hospitalized with community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) during and after the COVID-19 pandemic public health restrictive measures. aiming to provide a foundation for clinical diagnosis, treatment, and policy formulation.MethodsThis multicenter retrospective study spanned January 2019 to December 2023.

pmc-12421676.title: Binding of Antimicrobial Peptide Indolicidin to DMPC Bilayer Using Replica-Exchange Molecular Dynamics
pmc-12421676.creator: Alex R. Fitz, Dmitri K. Klimov, Christopher Lockhart
pmc-12421676.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cationic antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are toxic to microbes, such as bacteria and fungi, and have been increasingly studied as an alternative to traditional antibiotics, in part because AMPs are bactericidal with a minimum risk of developing bacterial resistance. Indolicidin (IL) is an AMP derived from bovine neutrophils that is unique due to its high prevalence of tryptophan and proline amino acids and its disordered structure. In addition to its antimicrobial activity, IL has exhibited toxicity toward mammalian cells, resulting in hemolysis.

pmc-12733793.title: Dopaminergic Genetic Variation and Trait Impulsivity: The Role of COMT rs4680 in Mixed Behavioral and Substance Addictions
pmc-12733793.creator: Gabriela Zdunek, Remigiusz Recław, Aleksandra Suchanecka, Krzysztof Chmielowiec, Dariusz Larysz, Marta Kuczak-Wójtowicz, Kinga Łosińska, Jolanta Chmielowiec, Anna Grzywacz, Lluís Ribas de Pouplana, Giuseppe Marano
pmc-12733793.description: Background: Impulsivity is a multidimensional trait associated with the development and maintenance of behavioral and substance addictions. Genetic polymorphisms, particularly within the dopaminergic system, are thought to modulate individual differences in impulsivity. The COMT rs4680 (Val158Met) polymorphism influences enzymatic activity of catechol-O-methyltransferase and may alter dopaminergic tone in the prefrontal cortex.

pmc-13090156.title: Incidence of Hodgkin and Non‐Hodgkin Lymphomas: Comparison of the Military and General Population
pmc-13090156.creator: Kimberly R. Robins, Julie A. Bytnar, Christin B. DeStefano, Craig D. Shriver, Kangmin Zhu
pmc-13090156.description: BackgroundLymphoma risk varies by demographics, environmental/occupational exposures, and medical care between active‐duty service members (ADSM) and the general US population (GUSP). This study compared age‐adjusted incidence rates and trends of Hodgkin lymphoma (HL) and non‐Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) between these groups.

pmc-13209035.title: The impact of LEP gene polymorphisms located at exon 2 (LEP-HinfI) and intron 2 (LEP-Sau3AI) on growth and reproductive traits in Saanen goats
pmc-13209035.creator: Nursen Senturk, Tugce Necla Selvi, Mustafa Demir, Hakan Ustuner, Hale Samli, Sena Ardicli
pmc-13209035.description: Leptin (LEP), alternatively recognized as the obesity gene, influences food consumption, energy balance, and lipid metabolism. Additionally, it plays a crucial role in energy metabolism, and variations in the LEP gene have been studied extensively among various livestock species. These investigations have unveiled correlations with traits such as meat quality, milk yield and composition, and growth characteristics.

pmc-13276738.title: Cambio de paradigma en las curas paliativas modernas: necesidad de un enfoque multidimensional
pmc-13276738.creator: Maria Prats Orvay, Ana Lozano
pmc-13276738.description: a a la Pregunta Sorpresa negativa (PS-) y que, aun así, presentaron necesidades paliativas. Con este resultado no se cuestiona el valor de la pregunta como herramienta clínica, sino que se evidencian sus limitaciones y la necesidad de interpretarla dentro de una valoración más amplia, siempre por parte de un equipo de profesionales entrenados.

pmc-13296703.title: Ocular Safety of Intravitreal Engineered Humanized Anti-VEGF Nanobody and Its Efficacy in the Attenuation of Choroidal Neovascularization and Associated Subretinal Fibrosis
pmc-13296703.creator: Mir Salar Kazemi, Mozhgan Rezaei Kanavi, Fatemeh Kazemi-Lomedasht, Reza Ahangari Cohan, Golnoosh Mahjoobi, Sare Safi, Sadra Ashrafi, Hamid Ahmadieh, Alireza Shoari, Mahdi Behdani
pmc-13296703.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Current treatments for choroidal neovascularization (CNV) and its associated subretinal fibrosis (SRF), major causes of vision loss, are limited by the need for frequent intravitreal injections and the emergence of drug resistance. This study evaluated the safety and efficacy of the intravitreal administration of engineered humanized anti-vascular endothelial growth factor Nanobodies, including a wild-type Nanobody (WHNb) and two mutated variants (MHNb136 and MHNb256), in a rat model of laser-induced CNV and associated SRF.

pmc-13344835.title: Modeling feed intake in lactating sows during summer considering temperature and humidity covariates
pmc-13344835.creator: Qianqian Huang, Maria V Souza, Hyatt Frobose, Hinayah R Oliveira, Luiz F Brito, Allan P Schinckel
pmc-13344835.description: Heat stress during lactation reduces voluntary feed intake (FI) and milk production in sows, thereby limiting piglet growth. In this context, the main objectives of this study were to compare alternative models for describing daily FI over a 22-d lactation and to evaluate temperature- and humidity-related environmental covariates under commercial conditions.

pmc-13470495.title: VLM-fusion: an intelligent diagnostic system for rural teacher professional development integrating vision-language models and adaptive learning path optimization
pmc-13470495.creator: Lumei Wang
pmc-13470495.description: Rural teachers face persistent professional development challenges stemming from geographic isolation, limited training resources, and scarce peer collaboration opportunities. This paper presents an intelligent diagnostic system that integrates vision-language model (VLM) capabilities with adaptive learning path optimization to deliver personalized, context-aware development support for rural educators.

pmc-13475038.title: Anesthetic Management of a Pediatric Patient With CTNNB1-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder: A Case Report
pmc-13475038.creator: Ana Rita Rocha, Conceição Cardante Santos, Petra Alves, Cristina Peixoto Gomes
pmc-13475038.description: CTNNB1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with spastic diplegia and visual defect (NEDSDV) is a rare genetic condition characterized by developmental delay, axial hypotonia, peripheral spasticity, and ophthalmologic abnormalities. Due to its phenotypic overlap with bilateral spastic cerebral palsy, NEDSDV may be underdiagnosed, and its anesthetic implications remain undocumented.

pmc-13507335.title: Toxic effects of Annona squamosa seed extracts against Tuta absoluta (Meyrick) (Lepidoptera: Gelechiidae) and their enzymatic response
pmc-13507335.creator: Kannan Swathy, Perumal Vivekanandhan, Sunanta Piyachat, Siripan Thanandon, Pittarate Sarayut, Supamit Mekchay, Peng Han, Patcharin Krutmuang

pmc-13615676.title: Song recognition in Floridian Ormia ochracea reflects multidimensional temporal tuning
pmc-13615676.creator: Lauren J Bitner, Jimena A Dominguez, Luke Bemish, Quang Vu, Julia F Morgan, David A Gray, Andrew C Mason, Norman Lee
pmc-13615676.description: Acoustic communication signals often contain a complex temporal structure, yet how this temporal structure contributes to signal recognition is poorly understood, particularly in eavesdropping receivers. The parasitoid fly Ormia ochracea localises host crickets by eavesdropping on their calling songs. In Florida, preferred host songs consist of sound pulses repeated at ∼50 pulses s−1, and flies exhibit matching preferences.
